description: Lists the current analysis presets (qualitative methods): preset id and version, title, description, required and optional input slots, the analysis steps and the report types each preset can produce. Call it before quoting or starting an analysis to choose a `preset_id` and valid `selected_reports`. No account needed. It returns no prices: use qualitative_quote_analysis for the price of a concrete analysis.
name: qualitative_list_presets
title: List analysis presets
